notes.title: OPEN BETA TESTING
notes.content: [h2]Very soon we will announce the start date of the open beta testing worldwide. [/h2][p][/p][p][i][b]This is a big event, which we ourselves are eagerly awaiting. We are trying to prepare the starting kit of the game as much as possible for the best experience, and in our VKontakte group we publish pre-release updates! At the moment, we have almost completed the preparation, and there are very few implementations and changes left that need to be made for the release of the game.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Main: [/b][/p][p][b]Implementation of 3 types of biomes (Summer, Spring, Winter) Add the game to your wishlist and follow the news![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313134/9aa70888e50324777bc6f5d762ca7312edce9d88.png"][/img][/p]
